name: 06-secondary-storage
title: Secondary storage (NFS)
description: Take nfs-01 from cloud-init Ubuntu to the zone's secondary storage: NFS kernel server, /export/secondary with CloudStack-compatible options, exported to the lab management subnet only — no primary export, because primary storage in the reader lab is Ceph RBD.
source: Generated from runbooks/lab/lab-nfs-01.yaml in the MatrixClaw lab repository. That runbook built this phase of the real 32 GB estate on 20-21 July 2026; the run records hold every command's exit code and output.
honesty: Steps change this machine and are gated. Each carries an 'already' probe, so a re-run skips what is done rather than repeating it. Checks are read-only and carry exact-match markers so they cannot pass on their own error text.

steps.title: Apt nfs server
steps.run: sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 update -q && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get -o DPkg::Lock::Timeout=300 install -y -q nfs-kernel-server chrony && sudo systemctl enable --now chrony
